title: Thirdway (Hollin)
description: A warm editorial look for an interior-design practice: cream paper, olive-black ink, tight neo-grotesk headings at weight 500 with heavy negative tracking, a light old-style serif for small labels, 2–4px corners, hairlines instead of shadows, and photography as the only colour.
notes: light is the faithful mode; blocks on photos and the footer add the `dark` class to themselves, and `.dark` is the sibling mode (ink page, cream type)
headings are Host Grotesk 500 with -0.06em tracking: the look depends on that tight spacing
the theme adds --typeface-serif (Newsreader) next to the three standard faces; thirdway blocks use it as font-[family-name:var(--typeface-serif)]
highlight is the deep teal #3d6062 and glow the butter #ffe7a6, the original's project accents
name: thirdway-theme
